account_signals: Customer described a potential data exposure incident where a supplier saw competing bid amounts
customer_reply: Hello, thank you for reaching out and reporting this incident. We take data privacy and security very seriously. Our Security team has been immediately engaged to investigate this matter. We recommend pausing any ongoing sourcing events related to this incident until our Security team confirms containment. We will follow up with updates as soon as possible.
internal_note: Customer reported that during a reverse auction, a supplier could see the bid amounts of a competing supplier. Per KB-6401 (Handling suspected data exposure between suppliers or tenants), any report of users/suppliers seeing data they should not see must be classified as Category: security, Priority: P1, routed to Security, and escalated immediately. Do not attempt reproduction in tenant.
